how_to_apply: Visit the NPCC website or the direct application link: recruit-jobs.in/npcc.
Read the full advertisement and confirm you meet all eligibility conditions for the post before applying.
Register and fill in the online application form with accurate personal, qualification, and experience details.

Upload the required documents in legible condition, including proof of date of birth, marksheets/degree certificates, proof of post-qualification experience, latest pay-in-slip, Form-16 for the last two financial years (if applicable), category/disability/EWS certificates (as applicable), and Aadhaar Card.
Pay the applicable application fee (Rs. 500 for General/OBC candidates, Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/EWS/Ex-Servicemen) through the online payment gateway.
Submit the application on or before the closing date of 29.08.2026, 11:59 PM.

content_sections.heading: NPCC Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NPCC Recruitment 2026 covers 22 posts split across two locations. 10 posts are for the Engineering & Design Division at NPCC's Corporate Office, Gurugram, and 12 posts are under the Chhattisgarh Zone. The notification states that the number of vacancies may increase or decrease depending on NPCC's requirements.

tables.caption: Corporate Office, Gurugram - Engineering & Design Division

content_sections.heading: NPCC Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is assessed as on the cutoff date of 31.07.2026 for age, qualification, and post-qualification experience. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply, and all qualifications must be from Indian Universities/Institutes recognized by UGC/AICTE. Only post-qualification experience gained after the declaration of the qualifying result/certificate, up to the cutoff date, will be counted. Candidates with degrees carrying CGPA/OGPA or a grading system must indicate the equivalent percentage as per their University/Institute's norms.

rows.essential_qualification: 3-year regular Diploma in Civil Engineering (draftsmanship experience preferred)
3-year regular Diploma in Electrical Engineering (draftsmanship experience preferred)
CA / CMA / MBA (Finance, min. 2-year duration) / Post Graduate in a relevant discipline

content_sections.heading: NPCC Age Limit
content_sections.text: Consultant-Projects: upper age limit 63 years All other posts: upper age limit 40 years Age relaxation for all posts except Consultant-Projects: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), and as per Government of India rules for PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates Age is reckoned as on the cutoff date of 31.07.2026

content_sections.heading: NPCC Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fees can be paid only through the online payment gateway; no other mode of payment is accepted. Fees once paid are non-refundable and will not be held in reserve for future selections.

content_sections.heading: NPCC Salary
content_sections.text: In addition to consolidated remuneration, the employer's Provident Fund contribution at 12% will be borne by NPCC, and a fixed Medical Allowance of Rs. 1,250 per month will be paid for all posts except Consultant-Projects. The Selection Committee may offer higher consolidated remuneration based on relevant work experience.

content_sections.heading: NPCC Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on Personal Interview, or any other appropriate method decided by NPCC depending on the response received for each post. NPCC's decision on the selection method and final result will be final and binding. Selected candidates will be issued an "Offer of Appointment" and must undergo a medical fitness examination by an approved Government hospital/medical board before joining. Merely submitting an application and appearing to meet the eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NPCC Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No.500518/Contract/2026/II) is a contract-basis hiring drive by National Projects Construction Corporation Limited for 22 engineering, architecture, and finance-support posts at its Gurugram Corporate Office and in its Chhattisgarh Zone.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 22 total vacancies: 10 posts at the Corporate Office, Gurugram, and 12 posts under the Chhattisgarh Zone.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 29.08.2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. When does the NPCC Recruitment 2026 application process start?
faq.answer: Online applications open on 08.08.2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post: ME/M.Tech for Site Engineer (Structural), B.Arch for Site Engineer (Architect), a relevant Bachelor's degree for other Site Engineer and Junior Engineer posts, a 3-year Diploma for Junior Engineer posts, and a Graduate degree or CA/CMA/MBA(Finance)/Post Graduate qualification for Consultant-Projects and Sr. Associate (Finance) respectively.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 63 years for Consultant-Projects and 40 years for all other posts, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), and as per Government rules for PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 per application for General and OBC candidates, and Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/EWS/Ex-Servicemen candidates, payable only through the online payment gateway.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through Personal Interview, or any other method NPCC deems appropriate based on the number of applications received.
